summary: Completed comprehensive testing of forex strategy tester application. All core functionality working correctly including authentication, chart display, backtesting, and strategy management.
passed_tests: User registration flow - successfully creates account and redirects to dashboard
User login flow - admin@example.com / admin123 authentication working
Logout functionality - properly clears session and redirects to login
Dashboard loads with candlestick chart showing EUR/USD data
Currency pair selector changes pair and reloads chart (tested EUR/USD to GBP/USD)
Timeframe selector changes timeframe (tested 1H to 4H)
Strategy type selector switches between strategies (tested MA Crossover to RSI)
Run Backtest button executes backtest and shows results (4 trades generated)
Trade history table populates after backtest
Replay controls - step forward/backward functionality working
Chart display with proper blue bearish and red bullish candles
GET /api/forex/pairs returns list of currency pairs
GET /api/forex/data/EUR-USD returns proper OHLC data structure
POST /api/backtest returns backtest results with trades and statistics
POST /api/auth/register creates new user account
POST /api/auth/login authenticates users with httpOnly cookies
GET /api/auth/me returns current user information
POST /api/auth/logout clears authentication cookies
POST /api/indicators/calculate returns indicator calculations
Strategy CRUD operations - create, list, delete working
Alpha Vantage API fallback to generated data working correctly

success_percentage.frontend: 95% (19/20 UI tests passed - minor issues with some advanced controls)
